1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 325 Apr. 3 Frank Kuhawck - 16 - blind now 19 months .... 3 Mrs ... 66 of Kalamazoo - heart given up a few days ago .... better. Mrs. Vandale - 47 - spells Adolph Menard - 66 - rhumatism and vericose veins.
Oscar Macey - wife & 5 struggling, was robbed ($20)
3 John Law - 34 - now in Sarasota, Florida, bursitis, rhumatic fever three months now. Enrolled To-night as perpetual member.
Mrs. Flanery - elderly .. groth on nose .... O.K.
5 Stefania Kus - 18 - Spinal maningitis (in Harper) Semi conscious ... Enrolled To-day (2.00) mother promises more frequent Com ... once a yr. - father not to confes in yrs.
Page 326 Blank Page.
Page 327
Apr. 5 Mrs. Tucker - 20 - lost memory & mind-improving since enrolled two weeks ago.
7 Eugene Dupuis - 47 - of St. Joachims, Ontario - 12 yrs. rhumatism of Spine. Enrolled Today for 2 yrs.
Catherine Kronibus - 14 - Seven week blind. Enrolled March. Enrol- led last Sunday March 31 perpetually in Thanksgiving- improved same evening when mother dropped medicine into her eyes she jumped with joy - frightened mother till she exclaimed. "I can see!" Deo Gr.
Owen Kenney Baroner of Toledo - 13 - hurt at birth and about size of 4 yr. old ... paralysis.
7 Alma Cody - 20 - entirely helpless and given up by Dr's last Tues- day - phoned to have her prayed for & enrolled ... improving since - enrolled doubly To-night.
Martha Opaleski .... Losing house ..
Blank Page.
Page 328 Page 329 Apr. 9 John Cullen - 22 - Epileptic for 13 yrs.
